title: Chapter 83: How Do I Complete This Mission?
html:
“For the sake of the child’s future recovery and your personal safety, please be careful.”

“I understand.”

After hanging up, Chen Ge leaned against the toilet wall, his thoughts in a knot. If Fan Yu was not the killer, then his aunt had to be. The prime suspects were also the victims’ closest family.

In any case, it is certain that Fan Yu’s aunt is hiding something from me. Something else must have happened that rainy night several years ago.

Why would the people closest to the victims become their killers? The mystery baffled Chen Ge.

The crime scene was at Mu Yang High School, perhaps I can find some clues here.

Chen Ge restarted the livestream. The chat still lagged, but the footage was much clearer. After a quick apology to his viewers, he left the second-floor toilet with his mallet in hand and swept his flashlight across the floor. There were no footprints.

I definitely heard footsteps while I hid behind the door. They stopped at the entrance, but no footprints means whoever made them wasn’t alive.Chen Ge peered down the stairs. He had last heard them descending.

He did not know whether the footsteps belonged to the mission’s red shadow, but decided to avoid them for now. Flashlight raised, he climbed toward the third floor. Halfway up, the footsteps echoed again.

They came from the first floor. Two ‘people’ were climbing the stairs side by side.

Have they discovered me?Chen Ge immediately switched off his flashlight, stuck his back to the wall, and stared closely at the mouth of the staircase.

The footsteps did not stop, and they walked onto the second floor.

It sounds like they’re heading into the second-floor toilet?Just as this thought crossed Chen Ge’s mind, the sound of cubicle doors being opened appeared beside his ears.

Six cubicle doors opened in succession. Whatever was inside seemed to be searching each stall. Chen Ge leaned toward the railing and tried to glimpse the second floor.

When the doors stopped, so did the footsteps. The building fell so quiet that everything he had heard seemed imagined. He waited on the stairs for five minutes, but no further sound came from the second-floor toilet.

The lack of footsteps means that the walking spirits are now inside the toilet. They’re probably hiding in one of the cubicles, waiting to ambush me.Chen Ge might have a powerful heart, but it did not mean that he had no fear. A surprise from inside the toilet cubicle would probably scare him quite a bit.

If the spirits are hiding in the second-floor toilet, this is my chance to inspect the third.Chen Ge left his flashlight off. The Yin Yang Vision he had earned from a Nightmare Mission was not as magical as the black phone claimed, but it had sharpened his night vision far beyond normal.

Lightning flashed intermittently, offering brief glimpses of his surroundings. Each burst sharpened the eerie atmosphere, and he feared the next might reveal something he did not want to see.

At the third-floor toilet, Chen Ge checked both ends of the corridor several times. Seeing nothing, he stepped inside.

The third-floor toilet was stranger than the two below. Its window was boarded up and its walls unstained, as though the room had been abandoned even before the school closed.

All six cubicle doors were shut, and Chen Ge felt each concealed an unpleasant surprise. The fifth and sixth stalls downstairs had merely stored cleaning supplies. Could these be the same?

He approached the first door and listened. No sound came from within—no crying infant or giggling girl as he had imagined. Then he did something braver still: he knelt and peered through the gap beneath the door.

Empty?

There were no mops or brooms, but no pair of legs either. It was an ordinary cubicle.

Chen Ge pressed the door, and it opened easily. The cubicle was unnaturally clean. Without the dust coating every surface, he might have believed someone scrubbed it daily.

The whole education block looks like it was burned down in a fire, but this toilet shows no signs of burning—this is similar to that classroom on the first floor.This similarity attracted Chen Ge’s attention. That basically confirms that this is my mission venue.

He pushed open the other cubicles before stopping at the fifth.

I have a very bad feeling. Could there be a nasty surprise waiting for me behind this door?Chen Ge patted the doll inside his shirt pocket and used his mallet to shove the door open.

The door swung open. At the sight within, Chen Ge recoiled. Drawings of life-sized eyes covered every surface of the fifth cubicle.

Before opening it, Chen Ge had imagined a pale-faced girl, a terrifying monster, or a blood-soaked madman. He had not imagined this.

Why are there so many eyes on the walls and boards?

A chill ran down his spine. Innumerable eyes seemed to stare at him. His legs trembled even outside the cubicle; stepping inside would be far worse.

Which psycho did this and why?!

The eyes seemed to spy on whoever used the cubicle. Shuddering, Chen Ge hurriedly shut the door. Mere drawings or not, their collective stare made his skin crawl.

I’ve found the mission site, but how am I supposed to complete the quest? Hide inside while all those eyes stare at me and wait for the red shadow? Isn’t that asking a little much?

After studying the cubicle, Chen Ge moved to the sixth and found the same mass of painted eyes.

However, different from the fifth cubicle, the eyes in the sixth cubicle were only drawn on the wall and partition that was shared with the fifth cubicle; the other walls were completely clean.
